_comment: A fictional outline in the shape storymaker.getOutline returns, for beat_map.py tests. Its middle is thin on purpose: no midpoint, no rising pressure, and no dark night before the answer.

chapters.title: The Weighing House
chapters.summary: Ilse Varro weighs salt at dawn in the Lantern Guild's weighing house, proud of a ledger she believes is fair. Bram tells her a fair scale is only as honest as the hand on it, and she laughs it off.

chapters.title: A Letter from Karsk
chapters.summary: A letter arrives: Bram is summoned to Karsk to answer for a short shipment, and he sends Ilse in his place with the cart.

chapters.title: Two Roads
chapters.summary: Ilse argues with her mother about going, counts her coin twice, and almost refuses.

chapters.title: The Oath at the Gate
chapters.summary: At the city gate Ilse swears the salt oath in her own name and takes the cart out onto the road.

chapters.title: The Tidemark Buyer
chapters.summary: On the road she meets Mara Quell, a Tidemark Combine buyer who offers twice the guild price and shows her how a buyer reads a tally.

chapters.title: Market Days
chapters.summary: Ilse sells in three villages, learns to haggle, loses a cartwheel and wins a feud with a toll keeper.

chapters.title: More Market Days
chapters.summary: Ilse sells at the Karsk market and makes a friend of the toll keeper's daughter.

chapters.title: Karsk
chapters.summary: She reaches Karsk; the guild house is closed for a festival, so she waits and drinks with the carters.

chapters.title: The Ledger Room
chapters.summary: Ilse is caught in the guild's ledger room and accused of stealing the tally book. Her oath is struck and her cart is seized.

chapters.title: Bram's Hand
chapters.summary: In a cell she understands what Bram meant: the hand on the scale was his. Mara's way of reading a tally shows her how to prove it.

chapters.title: The Public Weighing
chapters.summary: Ilse demands a public weighing before the guild masters and proves the tally false with Mara's method.

chapters.title: The Weighing House Again
chapters.summary: Back home, Ilse weighs salt at dawn and checks every hand on every scale. Bram's name is struck from the ledger.
